Header_Dashboard: Overview of the selected Linux VPS
Header_Storage: Disk, images, volumes and large directories
Header_Settings: VPS Desk preferences and local security
Shell_PendingModule: This module is part of the v2 migration plan and will be enabled after the current operations foundation is validated.
Servers_AgentlessHelp: VPS Desk connects directly over SSH; no VPS Desk agent is installed on the server.
Servers_HostFingerprintHelp: When supplied, VPS Desk rejects a server whose SSH host key does not match.
Dashboard_PerformanceHelp: CPU and memory · live samples · auto refresh 10s after first successful connection
Dashboard_RecentActivityHelp: Operation history will appear here as modules are enabled.
Containers_Subtitle: Inventory and live stats are read directly over SSH. No Docker API port is exposed.
Containers_ActionHelp: Start, stop and restart require an explicit confirmation.
Containers_SafetyNote: Container deletion, image pruning and volume removal are intentionally not exposed here yet.
Deployments_Subtitle: Guarded Git + Docker Compose workflow with preflight and post-deploy verification.
Deployments_RemoteRepositoryTooltip: Path inside the VPS where the project is already cloned (e.g. /root/my-app). This is where git and docker compose run for the deployment.
Deployments_SaveProfileTooltip: Saves path, branch, Compose and non-sensitive options for the active server. Passwords, keys and secrets are never saved.
Deployments_ProjectPlaceholder: Choose a Compose project discovered on the VPS
Deployments_ExecuteTooltip: Discovers options when needed and validates the VPS before asking for final confirmation. It does not modify containers until you confirm.
Deployments_DiscoverTooltip: Connects over SSH and reads which branches and *.yml files actually exist in the remote repository, to fill the lists below.
Deployments_RunPreflightTooltip: Checks before touching the server: SSH connection, installed tools, and that the chosen branch and compose file really exist.
Deployments_WorkflowHelp: Choose Run deployment: VPS Desk discovers and validates automatically. It asks for confirmation only before changing the server.
Deployments_BranchTooltip: Git branch to deploy (the server does git fetch/checkout/pull on this branch).
Deployments_BranchPlaceholder: Choose a branch discovered on the server
Deployments_ComposeFileTooltip: docker-compose*.yml file in the remote repository that defines the services to bring up (api, front, database, etc.).
Deployments_ComposePlaceholder: Choose a Compose file discovered on the server
Deployments_RequireEnvTooltip: When on, the deployment stops if this .env file does not exist on the server — prevents bringing up containers with blank variables.
Deployments_PullImagesTooltip: Pulls the Docker images the compose file references from a registry, before building/starting.
Deployments_BuildImagesTooltip: Rebuilds the images defined in the compose file (equivalent to 'docker compose up --build'). If off, uses the images that already exist.
Deployments_HealthUrls: HTTP health URLs after deployment (optional, one per line)
Deployments_HealthHelp: Checks run from the VPS after Compose finishes. No Holos/ABP endpoint is hardcoded.
Deployments_PostDeployHelp: Container state/health plus optional HTTP smoke checks. A zero exit code is not treated as proof that the release is healthy.
Deployments_OutputHelp: Git fetch/checkout/fast-forward → optional image pull → Compose up → Compose status → post-deploy verification
Logs_Subtitle: Read Docker logs and systemd journal entries directly over SSH.
Storage_Subtitle: Root filesystem and Docker storage usage.
Storage_VolumesHelp: No prune/delete actions are enabled yet
Files_Subtitle: Browse and edit small text files over SFTP. No remote shell command is used for file transfer.
Files_RemoteDirectoryHelp: Folders first · select an entry and open it
Files_EditorHelp: Only explicit Save writes to the VPS. Files larger than 2 MB are not opened in this editor.
Security_Subtitle: Read-only exposure and SSH posture checks. VPS Desk does not change firewall or sshd configuration from this screen.
